title: MessagePack values without a native R type — msgpack-values
text: msgpack_map() map whose keys non-empty, unique strs: integer keys, example. keys values lists equal length, order. msgpack_ext() extension object: type, whole number -128 127, data, payload raw vector. Type -1 timestamp; negative types reserved specification. msgpack_bigint() integer outside double holds exactly, stored canonical decimal text. accepts decimal strings, whole numbers within 2^53. title: Decode MessagePack — msgpack_decode
text: Turns MessagePack bytes ordinary R values. whole input checked first – well-formedness, validity, duplicate keys limits, exactly msgpack_validate() – nothing built check passes, length count head make R allocate data input hold.

title: Decode MessagePack — msgpack_decode
code: msgpack_decode(   x,   simplify = c("preserve", "none"),   map_keys = c("auto", "map", "string"),   big_integers = c("bigint", "double", "error"),   duplicate_keys = FALSE,   max_depth = 256L,   max_size = 64 * 1024^2,   max_items = 1e+06 )  msgpack_decode_seq(   x,   simplify = c("preserve", "none"),   map_keys = c("auto", "map", "string"),   big_integers = c("bigint", "double", "error"),   duplicate_keys = FALSE,   max_depth = 256L,   max_size = 64 * 1024^2,   max_items = 1e+06 )

title: Decode MessagePack — msgpack_decode
text: x raw vector holding exactly one MessagePack object (msgpack_decode()), zero objects back back (msgpack_decode_seq()). simplify "preserve" simplifies arrays whose elements agree atomic vectors; "none" makes every array list. map_keys "auto" gives named list every key non-empty, unique str, msgpack_map otherwise. "map" always gives msgpack_map. "string" always gives named list, naming entry str key, text rendering key (1, 1.0, nil, h'00ff', ext(5, h'01'), [1, ""]); lossy, refuses map whose keys collide named. big_integers integer beyond 2^53, double hold exactly: "bigint" returns msgpack_bigint, "double" nearest double, "error" refuses input. duplicate_keys FALSE (default), map key twice invalid. max_depth Deepest nesting allowed, counting arrays, maps extension objects. zumsgpack_info()$max_depth_cap. max_size Largest input allowed, bytes, Inf. max_items objects allowed, counting every array, map, key, value element, Inf.

title: Decode MessagePack — msgpack_decode
text: decoded value; msgpack_decode_seq(), list one element per object.

title: Decode MessagePack — msgpack_decode
text: array simplifies atomic vector elements agree: integers floats combine wider; booleans stay logical, text stays text; wide integers integer-valued numbers combine msgpack_bigint. nil joins NA. Anything else – raw vectors, nested arrays maps, exts, booleans numbers, mixture – list. [] logical(0). one-element array simplifies marked (), encoder writes back array rather single value. str holding U+0000 R string zumsgpack_unrepresentable.

title: Decode MessagePack — msgpack_decode
code: msgpack_decode(as.raw(c(0x93, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03)))        # [1, 2, 3] #> [1] 1 2 3 msgpack_decode(as.raw(c(0x81, 0xa1, 0x61, 0xc3)))        # {"a": true} #> $a #> [1] TRUE #>   # Integer keys, so a msgpack_map. msgpack_decode(as.raw(c(0x81, 0x01, 0xd0, 0xf9)))        # {1: -7} #> <msgpack_map: 1 entry> #> [[1]] #> [1] -7  msgpack_decode_seq(as.raw(c(0x01, 0xa1, 0x61)))          # 1, then "a" #> [[1]] #> [1] 1 #>  #> [[2]] #> [1] "a" #>

title: Encode R values as MessagePack — msgpack_encode
text: Turns R value MessagePack bytes, deterministically: identical R objects give identical bytes every session every platform.

title: Encode R values as MessagePack — msgpack_encode
code: msgpack_encode(   x,   auto_unbox = TRUE,   max_depth = 256L,   floats = c("double", "shortest") )  msgpack_encode_seq(   x,   auto_unbox = TRUE,   max_depth = 256L,   floats = c("double", "shortest") )

title: Encode R values as MessagePack — msgpack_encode
text: x R value. msgpack_encode_seq(), list whose elements encoded one another, objects back back. auto_unbox TRUE, length-one atomic vector single value; FALSE, array one. Names used map keys always single strings. max_depth Deepest nesting write, counting arrays, maps exts msgpack_decode() , output always decodes max_depth. floats "double" writes every non-integral double float 64; "shortest" writes float 32 holds value exactly. default, since decoders widen float 32 type changes value users see.

title: Encode R values as MessagePack — msgpack_encode
text: raw vector.

title: Encode R values as MessagePack — msgpack_encode
text: length-one atomic vector single value, array, unless wrapped () auto_unbox = FALSE. matrix flat array column-major order. Whole doubles become integers R integer literal: -7 written R double, float different value integer protocol expects. 1L 1 encode identically. MessagePack form raise zumsgpack_unsupported_type: complex numbers, functions, environments, external pointers, S4 objects POSIXlt (convert .POSIXct()). Names partly missing, NA empty zumsgpack_invalid_argument, two keys encode identically zumsgpack_duplicate_key.

title: Encode R values as MessagePack — msgpack_encode
text: MessagePack's specification says encoder use smallest integer form. zumsgpack always writes: smallest form every integer every length count; float 64 every non-integral double, floats = "shortest" float 32 holds value exactly; every NaN one canonical quiet NaN, since R's NaN bits differ platforms; str text bin bytes, never pre-2013 raw; map entries sorted bytewise order encoded keys, duplicate keys. zumsgpack's rules, format's: another decoder entitled expect , msgpack_validate() check . make output byte-identical across calls, sessions platforms, signature content hash bytes needs.

title: Encode R values as MessagePack — msgpack_encode
text: Decoding msgpack_encode() wrote gives back value, except : NA comes back NULL, NA vector's type; whole double comes back integer; list(1L) 1L encode 1; NaN payload kept; float 32 input re-encodes float 64 unless floats = "shortest".

title: Encode R values as MessagePack — msgpack_encode
code: msgpack_encode(list(a = 1, b = c(2, 3))) #> [1] 82 a1 61 01 a1 62 92 02 03 msgpack_encode(c(1.5, NaN, Inf)) #>  [1] 93 cb 3f f8 00 00 00 00 00 00 cb 7f f8 00 00 00 00 00 00 cb 7f f0 00 00 00 #> [26] 00 00 00 msgpack_encode(0.5, floats = "shortest") #> [1] ca 3f 00 00 00  # Integer keys need msgpack_map(). msgpack_encode(msgpack_map(list(1L), list(-7))) #> [1] 81 01 f9  # Deterministic: map entries are sorted by their encoded keys. identical(msgpack_encode(list(b = 1, a = 2)), msgpack_encode(list(a = 2, b = 1))) #> [1] TRUE  msgpack_encode_seq(list(1, "a", TRUE)) #> [1] 01 a1 61 c3

title: Validate MessagePack — msgpack_validate
text: check covers well-formedness (every head, length count bytes , reserved byte 0xc1), UTF-8 every str, three legal layouts timestamp extension (type -1), duplicate map keys, limits. Keys compared value: integer 1 one byte uint 16 key, float 32 1.0 float 64 1.0; integer 1 float 1.0 different keys, str bin bytes. array map used key compared encoded bytes. MessagePack defines canonical form, deterministic argument: zumsgpack's encoder follows rules (see msgpack_encode()), decoder entitled expect.

title: Conditions raised by zumsgpack — zumsgpack-conditions
text: Every error zumsgpack raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zumsgpack_error.

title: Conditions raised by zumsgpack — zumsgpack-conditions
text: zumsgpack_invalid_argument argument unusable: input raw vector, flag TRUE FALSE, limit positive whole number within range. zumsgpack_parse_error input well-formed MessagePack: ends early (head, length count claims bytes ), uses reserved byte 0xc1, bytes object. zumsgpack_invalid_error input well-formed valid: str UTF-8, timestamp (ext type -1) whose payload 4, 8 12 bytes whose nanoseconds exceed 999,999,999. zumsgpack_duplicate_key map key twice duplicate_keys = FALSE. Keys compared value. zumsgpack_unrepresentable input valid holds value R , str containing U+0000. zumsgpack_unsupported_type R value MessagePack form given encoder. zumsgpack_handler_error extension handler raised error. zumsgpack_limit_error limit reached. subclasses zumsgpack_depth_limit, zumsgpack_size_limit, zumsgpack_item_limit zumsgpack_cell_limit name one. zumsgpack_io_error Reading input failed. condition raised checking input carries offset, 0-based byte offset object fault, status, name underlying status, "ZMP_ERR_TRUNCATED". diagnostics: branch class, . limit error also carries limit, argument's name, "max_depth", limit_value. zumsgpack_invalid_argument condition carries arg, argument fault.

what: zumsgpack: Deterministic and Secure 'MessagePack' Encoding and Decoding — zumsgpack-package
title: zumsgpack: Deterministic and Secure 'MessagePack' Encoding and Decoding — zumsgpack-package
text: Encodes R values 'MessagePack' (https://msgpack.org) decodes 'MessagePack' ordinary R vectors lists. Decoding checks whole input configurable depth, size item limits R object built, untrusted input network peers drive large allocations. Encoding deterministic: identical R objects always produce identical bytes. Timestamps convert 'POSIXct', extension types can given meaning user handlers.
